summary: A Monomachine-style synthesizer firmware: six tracks, each running one mono machine, with a 64-step parameter-lock sequencer and a lofi effects bus on a 1-bit styled screen.
features: Machines include SID-6581, three FM types, VOX-6 and LXR-style drums
Per track: filter, delay, distortion, three LFOs and an arpeggiator
64-step sequencer with p-locks, trig conditions, ratchets and polymeter
Bus with reverb, ADPCM crunch and 22 performance effects
Six MIDI channels, Monomachine CC map, MIDI clock in and out
One project of 64 patterns; saving overwrites other firmwares' data there
